content.text: Support confirmed three example.com tenants hit this in the last billing cycle.
After a mid-cycle plan change, some customers cannot download the current invoice from the Billing Questions portal action.
The download button returns a generic failure and the browser network tab shows a 404 for the invoice PDF resource id generated at plan change time.
Reproduce with a sandbox account that upgrades mid-cycle, capture the resource id mapping, and fix generation so post-change invoices remain downloadable.
